summary.headline: Xi launches a global AI cooperation body; Gatekeeper rises
summary.body: The day's big story came from Shanghai. In his first World AI Conference keynote, Xi Jinping announced a World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, reportedly with 29 founding countries, while criticising US export curbs. A new multi-country body is a real step for Global Coordination. That matters for Gatekeeper, the ending where nations work together to keep superintelligence in check, and it eases Self-Destruction, which feeds on a breakdown in cooperation. It also lifted 1984, because coordinated state control can cut both ways. Two smaller items: Tata set a mid-2028 start for India's first chip fab at Dholera, a slight spread of power away from the leaders, and China claimed its first commercial brain-chip implant, an unverified nudge to Human-AI Merging. Horizon Balance rose to 0.85.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.5, Self-Destruction -0.4 and 1984 +0.3 were driven by Xi's World AI Cooperation Organization announcement (+0.56, -0.40 and +0.32).

events.title: Xi launches World AI Cooperation Organization at Shanghai WAIC
events.summary: In his first World AI Conference keynote, Xi Jinping announced a Shanghai-based World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, reportedly with 29 founding countries, and criticized US export curbs.
events.reason: New multilateral AI body led by China; adds coordination though as a rival bloc.

events.title: Tata Electronics sets mid-2028 target for India's first chip fab at Dholera
events.summary: Reports detailed the roughly Rs 91,000 crore Tata-PSMC fab for up to 50,000 wafer starts a month; IT Minister Vaishnaw said operations should start mid-2028.
events.reason: Adds to sovereign compute and chip supply outside the US/Taiwan; still years away.

events.title: China claims first commercial invasive brain-chip implant
events.summary: Chinese reports said a brain-computer interface implant had moved from trials to commercial use; details are limited and unverified.
events.reason: BCI commercialisation claim; unverified so T1, D.
